value.body: Tax consultants advise individuals and businesses on tax planning, return filing and responding to notices from tax departments. They work in CA and law firms, consulting firms, or in their own practice, and the day involves client meetings, reviewing documents, filing returns and drafting replies.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: B.Com, BBA or LLB; CA or CMA for many advisory roles

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Income Tax and GST portals, Tally, Excel

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Most consultants first gain experience in a CA or tax firm. Representing clients before tax authorities depends on the qualification: CAs, advocates and certain registered practitioners have specific rights under the law, so check what each route allows.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Tax planning for individuals and businesses

value.title: At a glance
items: Independent practice takes time to build a client base.
Common next steps: tax manager, partner in a firm, or own practice.
Work is seasonal, with peaks near filing deadlines.
